description: This file contains shell script code that defines a test suite for disabling HTTP access in Git operations, including setup, configuration, and test cases involving cloning repositories over HTTP/HTTPS using Git commands.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the subsequent command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for patterns in the given output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Tests a specific protocol (HTTP/S) for Git.
